Responsibilities: Manage and maintain OT inventory on an ongoing basis. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Maintain and update Engineering standards, for approval by Principal Engineers, to ensure OT standards and requirements including ARS CIP and O&P are identified and adhered to. Support and document requirements associated with CIP event recoveries (responsible for Netcom and telecom devices). Demonstrate key behaviors and meet identified expectations outlined in our four cultural pillars - one team, continuous improvement, customer focus and personal accountability Requirements Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering. A working knowledge of AESO/NERC CIP compliance requirements or a strong background in general regulatory compliance as it relates to utilities/industrials.
